fields.name: form_number
fields.description: The specific ACORD form number (e.g., ACORD 125, ACORD 130).

fields.name: form_name
fields.description: Short title for the ACORD form.

fields.name: policy_number
fields.description: Unique identifier assigned by the insurer to this policy.

fields.name: insurance_company_name
fields.description: Name of the underwriting insurance company.

fields.name: named_insured
fields.description: Primary entity or individual listed as the insured on the policy.

fields.name: applicant_name
fields.description: Name of the applicant if different from the named insured.

fields.name: insured_address
fields.description: Physical or mailing address of the insured.

fields.name: policy_effective_date
fields.description: Date the policy coverage begins.

fields.name: policy_expiration_date
fields.description: Date the policy coverage ends.

fields.name: producer_name
fields.description: Name of the agent or agency that produced the policy.

fields.name: producer_address
fields.description: Address of the producing agent/agency.

fields.name: producer_phone
fields.description: Contact phone number for the agent/agency.

fields.name: policy_type
fields.description: Type of policy or line of business (e.g., CGL, Commercial Auto).

fields.name: coverage_details
fields.description: A list or summary of coverages and coverage parts included.

fields.name: coverage_limits
fields.description: Specified coverage limits for each coverage part.

fields.name: premium_amount
fields.description: Total or annual premium for the coverage.

fields.name: deductible
fields.description: Deductible amount the insured is responsible for per claim.

fields.name: claim_number
fields.description: Number assigned to a specific claim under this policy, if applicable.

fields.name: loss_date
fields.description: Date of a reported loss/incident if relevant to the form.

fields.name: loss_description
examples: Water damage due to burst pipe in office building.
fields.description: Summary of the reported incident or cause of loss.

fields.name: location_of_loss
fields.description: Where the loss occurred, if different from insured address.

fields.name: policyholder_signature
fields.description: Signature of the insured or policyholder verifying the information.

fields.name: agent_broker_signature
fields.description: Signature of the agent or broker representing the policy.

fields.name: additional_insureds
examples: Lender: Big Bank, Landlord: Real Estate Holdings
fields.description: List of extra parties who are named as insured under the policy.

fields.name: lienholder_mortgagee_name
fields.description: Entity holding a financial interest in the insured property/vehicle.

fields.name: vehicle_information
fields.description: Vehicle details if the ACORD form pertains to auto coverage.

fields.name: property_information
fields.description: Property details for commercial/residential lines of business.

fields.name: risk_classifications
fields.description: Risk classification codes or descriptions used by underwriters.

fields.name: endorsements
examples: Additional named insured endorsement, Blanket Waiver of Subrogation
fields.description: List or short summary of endorsements included with the policy.

fields.name: policy_status
fields.description: Indicates whether the policy is active, canceled, pending, etc.

document.document_description: ACORD forms are standardized insurance documents used by insurers and agencies to capture, update, and communicate policy-related data. They include applicant, policy, coverage, and loss information in a consistent format recognized across the insurance industry.
